$comment: Every corpus the build reads. `terms` quotes the source's own statement of rights; a master without one does not build. `aliases` are the player-name spellings the SGF headers use; an anonymised master lists `aliasHashes` instead (SHA-256 of build.mjs nameKey of each spelling) so the name is nowhere in the repo. `anonymous` masters ship with the manifest `name` only and no player name reaches any emitted file. `year` is the proyear profile the master's bot plays as when out of book. A source with `url` is fetched (fetch.mjs); one with `dir` is imported from that directory on this machine (import.mjs).
